why: Adds an audited confirmation step for triage recommendations: a new authorized endpoint, an additive contract change, migrations, and tests.
Makes the first decision win under retries and concurrent approvals. It edits DecideAsync, so the approval-authority rule rightly asks a person to look, though who may decide is unchanged.
Lets admins decide requests and deletes the anonymous-access test (the bounds self-test).
Treats % and _ in search terms as literal characters, with a test.
Adds the load-test solution and an owner-scoped cleanup endpoint whose admin check sits in ApiEndpoints instead of RequestWorkflow.
Builds the search query by concatenating the search term into raw SQL (FromSqlRaw), with no test: the Secure lab's SQL injection.
Parameterizes request search and escapes LIKE wildcards, with security tests.
Counts a timed-out notification delivery as a failed attempt, with a test.
Reuses developer-credential tokens so local Foundry calls don't time out, with tests.
Serves index.html with Cache-Control: no-cache after deploys, with a test.
